# LabelPro — India's First E-Commerce Label Studio

> Duplicate Remover • 4x6 Thermal Label Cropper • Smart SKU Sorter • Buyer & Return Analyser

LabelPro (https://labelpro.in) is India's first intelligent e-commerce shipping label operating platform built specifically for Meesho, Flipkart, and Amazon marketplace sellers. It eliminates double-dispatch packaging losses, automates 4x6 thermal shipping label cropping, sorts warehouse batches by SKU/courier, and uncovers district-level buyer repeat demand with 100% in-browser privacy.

## Core Tools and Utilities

- [Duplicate Label Remover](https://labelpro.in/remove-duplicate): In-browser cross-batch shipping label PDF comparator and internal repetition deduplicator for Meesho, Flipkart, and Amazon marketplace sellers.
- [Thermal Label Studio](https://labelpro.in/): Instant 4x6 thermal label cropping engine and dynamic marketing QR code stamper with crystal-clear vector barcode preservation.
- [District Demand & Customer Intelligence](https://labelpro.in/customer-analysis): Visual customer retention tracking, repeat buyer analytics, and pincode/district demand heatmap across Indian states.
- [Reverse Logistics & RTO Manager](https://labelpro.in/returns): Marketplace return CSV reconciler, customer returns vs courier RTO classifier, and SKU pause matrix to prevent ongoing advertising loss.
- [QR Scan Analytics & Conversions](https://labelpro.in/analytics): Real-time conversion tracking for customer engagement via packaging QR codes.
- [Custom Label Presets & Templates](https://labelpro.in/templates): Marketplace label crop presets and reusable branding templates.
